result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback E&O limit of USD 1M and adds USD 2M of cyber coverage, while retaining statutory workers’ compensation and certificates on request. However, it does not require CGL limits of USD 1M per occurrence and USD 2M aggregate; the existing undifferentiated USD 1M limit is insufficient. It also expands the cyber trigger beyond processing Customer Data to any access to Company data or Confidential Information, which may unnecessarily capture non-data confidential information. The language is generally understandable but should specify the CGL limit structure and align the cyber/privacy coverage and trigger with the playbook.
